## Checklist

- [ ] `bun test`, `bun run build`, and `bun run smoke` pass locally.
- [ ] Each change of behavior has a test. A fixed round-trip bug adds the document that showed it as a fixture.
- [ ] `DEVIATIONS.md` records each deliberate divergence from the Python reference.
- [ ] The docs agree with each change of public behavior.
- [ ] The commits obey Conventional Commits, and each commit has a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] The pull request holds one logical change.
